summary: Eyes wrenching in pain sprayed by lies of a Tyrant's Hubris. Truth emerges as a Hero of Swann Street spreads wings feathered in humanity wrapping stings of pain in visions of hope #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Eyes wrenching
  in pain
sprayed by
lies of a
Tyrant's Hubris.
Truth emerges as a
Hero of Swann Street
  spreads wings
feathered in
  humanity
wrapping stings
  of pain in visions
  of hope
#smallpoems
